hook.text: Users in Tokyo write to the Tokyo leader. Users in London write to the London leader. Both are authoritative.

buildup.text: Multi-leader replication allows writes at multiple nodes, each replicating to the others asynchronously.

discovery.text: This reduces write latency for geographically distributed users — writes go to the nearest leader.

twist.text: Two leaders can accept conflicting writes simultaneously. Conflict resolution is complex and error-prone.

climax.text: Multi-leader is powerful for global systems but introduces the hardest problem: concurrent write conflicts.

punchline.text: Multiple writers, global reach — but conflicts everywhere.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge of multi-leader replication?
options: Resolving conflicting writes from different leaders
